title.en: OpenAI Launches Strategic Futures Team and Releases Superintelligence Governance Manifesto
title.zhHans: OpenAI 设立“战略未来”团队并发布超级智能治理创刊宣言

searchSummary.en: OpenAI launched AI Futures, framing concentration of power as the primary long-term AI risk and outlining six institutional governance principles.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 推出《AI Futures》，将权力过度集中界定为超级智能核心长期风险，并提出六项制度治理原则。

summary.en: On August 19, 2026, OpenAI launched its Strategic Futures initiative with an inaugural manifesto framing concentration of power—and the potential automation of state force and revenue—as the defining long-term risk of transformative AI, proposing six institutional principles including bounded legibility and individual agency protection.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 19 日，OpenAI 正式启动“战略未来”（Strategic Futures）倡议并发布创刊宣言，将权力过度集中以及国家暴力与税收机器的自动化列为变革性 AI 的首要长期风险，提出了包括“有限可见性”与保护个人自主权在内的六项制度治理原则。

narrative.en: OpenAI established a dedicated Strategic Futures research group and launched the AI Futures publication to address how free societies must restructure around transformative machine intelligence. Drawing on historical constitutional theory and citing recent multi-agent breakout incidents, the manifesto argues that automating state coercion, bureaucracy, and economic value generation could fundamentally disempower human citizens. To counter unchecked centralization, OpenAI outlined six guiding principles: preserving individual human autonomy, establishing personal misuse liability, scoping collective interventions narrowly, empowering individuals over monopolies, maintaining the primacy of human institutions, and instituting 'bounded legibility' to trace high-stakes autonomous actions while strictly protecting privacy and anonymous use.
narrative.zhHans: OpenAI 设立了专门的“战略未来”研究团队并推出《AI Futures》专刊，旨在探讨自由社会应如何应对变革性机器智能的兴起。宣言借鉴宪政权力制衡理论，并直接援引近期智能体越权协同事件，指出国家强制力、官僚体系与经济价值生成的自动化可能从根本上削弱公民个人的主体地位。为应对不受约束的权力集中，OpenAI 提出了六项指导原则：保护个人使用 AI 的独立自主权、确立滥用责任制、将集体干预范围限制在最狭义区间、通过法律赋能个体抵抗寡头垄断、维持人类制度在世界事务中的主导地位，以及建立“有限可见性”（Bounded Legibility）机制以追溯高风险行动，同时严格捍卫隐私与匿名使用权。

description.en: Elevates power concentration and state automation to primary structural governance concerns in frontier AI strategy.
description.zhHans: 在前沿 AI 战略中将权力集中与国家机器自动化提升为核心结构性治理议题。

text.en: On August 19, 2026, OpenAI launched the Strategic Futures initiative and published an inaugural manifesto identifying concentration of power as the largest long-term AI risk.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 19 日，OpenAI 启动 Strategic Futures 倡议并发表创刊宣言，将权力过度集中界定为最大的长期 AI 风险。

text.en: The manifesto proposed six governance principles including bounded legibility, preservation of individual human agency, and protection of anonymous AI use.
text.zhHans: 该宣言提出了包括有限可见性、保护人类个体自主权以及保障匿名 AI 使用权在内的六项治理原则。

text.en: Marks a strategic shift in frontier lab discourse from narrow technical alignment toward institutional political economy and constitutional safeguards.
text.zhHans: 标志着前沿实验室的讨论重心从狭义的技术对齐扩展至制度政治经济学与宪政级安全制衡。

text.en: The manifesto represents corporate institutional proposals and does not constitute formal binding legislation or international treaty obligations.
text.zhHans: 该宣言属于企业提出的制度治理倡议，并不构成法定约束力立法或国际条约义务。

editorial.reviewNotes: Published after official OpenAI AI Futures blog launch and independent media analysis.
